title: fix(plugin-security)!: a computed field over a field the caller cannot read is hidden from that caller
body:
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data` (`rules/relationships.md`) teaches a rate as a `formula` over a `summary` and tells an author to mask the summary on a set that must not see it; that instruction is complete as written now, because a formula over the masked summary is withheld with it, so no page needs a new sentence.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:字段级安全现在覆盖计算字段的输入——调用者未被完整提供某字段时(权限集 `readable: false`、未满足 `requiredPermissions`、或按 `maskingRule` 打码),读取该字段的 formula / 存储计算字段对其隐藏:本记录直接引用、经 `label()` 之类函数、经另一计算字段;或经引用读取被引用对象声明的字段(调用者读不了该对象、读不了该字段、或只拿到打码值;被引用对象上经其自身引用而被扣下的存储字段亦然,沿链每个对象判一次)。写入载荷点名此类字段一律 403。
- 为什么改:字段级安全应当覆盖一个值由什么算出;此前计算字段不随其输入一起隐藏。
- 风险与回滚:收窄(BREAKING)。受影响者是输入字段被扣下却在读其上计算字段的调用者,包括对能力门控或打码字段的 View All / Modify All 持有者,以及无解码门的 `maskingRule` 下所有非系统调用者。读不出字段名的表达式在有任一其他字段未被完整提供时整体隐藏。公共表单的引擎回显不带任何经引用读取的计算字段。判的是字段,不是行(见变更集)。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/field-masker.ts`(读集、引用跳读与传递折叠)、`security-plugin-object-inputs.ts`(引用判定:被引用对象可读与完整提供的字段集)、`security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`(第 2.5 步写入拒绝、查询守卫、第 4 步与公共表单回显)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security exec vitest run src/formula-reads-hidden-field-masking.test.ts`,预期 67 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Field-level security now covers what a field's value is computed from. A computed field — a `formula`, computed on read, or a stored field declaring an `expression`, computed on write — is withheld from a caller who is not served whole a field it reads. Each input kind is pinned for a formula and for a stored field, with a control and an ablation:

- a field of its own record the caller may not read (a permission set marks it `readable: false`, or the caller fails its `requiredPermissions`) or is served masked (its `maskingRule`, gated or not), whether the expression names it directly, inside a function such as `label()`, or through another computed field;
- a field the referenced object declares, on the record the expression reads through one reference, where the caller may not read that object, may not read the field, or is served it masked, directly or through a computed field of the referenced object — including a stored field there that is withheld for what it reads through a reference of its own. A computed field reading through a chain of references is withheld when any field along the chain is withheld from the caller, however long the chain and wherever it comes back to an object it has already passed through: the withheld sets of every object the references reach grow together until none grows, each object resolved once per operation. A field the referenced object does not declare is no field to withhold: the formula reads `null`, as before;
- an expression whose reads cannot be named (a computed key, a method or macro on the record, the record handed whole to a function, a dialect other than CEL) is withheld whenever some other field of the object is not served whole to that caller (fail closed); such a field is also withheld for what it reads through a reference, as any computed field is.

What is judged is the field, not the row: a computed field is not withheld because the caller may not read the particular record a reference points at (a formula reads `null` there; a stored one keeps the value its writer computed).

The readers, each pinned at its own door with a control: `find` / `findOne` and a projection; the `insert` and `update` echoes; a write payload naming such a field (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, whatever value it carries); filtering, sorting, grouping and aggregating by a stored computed field (`403`; a `formula` is refused there for every caller already); `getReadableFields`, `getMetadataReadableFields` (and the object schema the metadata plane and `describe_object` serve), `getQueryableFields`, `getWritableFields` and `getRecordFieldAccess` (both halves); the explain `fls` layer; the `$expand` name of a `referenceNameVisible` reference (the floor name where the target's name field is withheld); a delegated read driven through the engine; and the record the engine echoes for a public-form grant, which carries no computed field that reads through a reference, for every submitter (the form submit route itself answers the created id only).

One derivation feeds every reader: each object's computed-field reads are taken once, from one parse, into the cached security posture; `foldComputedFieldReads` folds them, transitively, into the field map after the per-field capability fold and the delegator intersection; a computed field reading through a reference is judged by the caller's object admission and query projection of the referenced object (the fields served whole there), that projection folding the referenced object's own references in turn. The read projection stays the exact complement of what the read mask deletes, and the query projection still differs from it by exactly the fields served masked, as `packages/spec/src/contracts/security-service.ts` states; no spec text moves.

No change to `packages/spec`, to `packages/lint`, or to the metadata-plane schema scrub code.

Files: `field-masker.ts`, `security-plugin.ts`, `security-plugin-object-inputs.ts`, `security-plugin-field-readers.ts`, `security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts`, `explain-engine.ts`, `security-plugin-explain-access.ts`, the rule's test file, the two `describe_object` pins and the second-object ledger row named under Acceptance notes, the docs page `content/docs/permissions/field-level-security.mdx`, one changeset.

## Tests

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/formula-reads-hidden-field-masking.test.ts`: a real `ObjectQL` over a real SQL driver behind the real `SecurityPlugin`, 67 tests named by the rule. The input-kind × reader matrix:

- same record, `readable: false`: formula and stored; `find`, `findOne`, projection, both echoes, the four query positions, both read projections, query, write and record-access projections, explain, delegated read; payload refusal for a matching and a differing value, with control;
- same record, a failed `requiredPermissions`, and served masked (gated rule, and a rule with no unmask gate): formula and stored, each with a control (the capability, the unmask capability, a system context); a View All holder is still withheld them;
- `label()` and a computed field over a computed field: formula and stored, with control;
- through a reference: `readable: false`, a failed `requiredPermissions`, served masked, an object the caller may not read, a formula of the referenced object, and a stored field there that reads through a reference of its own (a chain of two); formula and stored for each, with control; an undeclared field reads `null` for every caller;
- fail closed, for a formula and a stored field, with control;
- the reference name door, the public-form echo and the delegated read, each with its control;
- controls: union of two sets, system context, View All over `readable: false`, the aggregate input gate unchanged;
- the read set: every literal spelling, held equal to the platform member reader (`analyzeRelationshipTraversals`), and the shapes it cannot name.

## Acceptance notes

- Two existing pins moved with the rule. Each now states a rule-named expectation, and no assertion was loosened. `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp-object-schema-mask.test.ts` used to hold that `describe_object` still served the member a stored expression over a field the member cannot read, with the expression stripped. Under this rule that field is withheld, so the pin now asserts it is not served, with a control: a caller who reads the input is served it. The stdio twin, `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.object-schema-mask.test.ts`, keeps its parity literal with it; its stubbed security answer is set to what the real service now answers.
- `packages/core/src/security/second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` classifies the new caller of the reference-target arbiter (`computedHopTargetsOf`, `field-masker.ts`) as not a served read.
- No author-time warning names a computed field over a field a set masks; the runtime withholds it either way.
